properties.value: Java SSL/TLS sessions using default configuration with JDK 21. While this uses modern TLS 1.3 by default, the underlying key exchange mechanisms (ECDHE/DH) are still classically vulnerable and need to be upgraded for post-quantum security.

properties.value: X25519 key agreement used for secure communications in Spark's network layer. This is a classical, retroactively breakable algorithm (B-) that needs to be upgraded to ML-KEM for post-quantum security.
